facts.text: I am looking for advice on how to stay on top of my finances.
I have been trying to track my spending.
I often make impulse purchases, especially for luxury items.
I spent $500 on a designer handbag at the mall last week.
I want to set clear financial goals and create a budget.
I want to avoid temptation, especially on social media.
I follow a few fashion influencers on Instagram.
Seeing designer outfits and luxury products on Instagram makes me want to splurge.
I want to unfollow or mute some social media accounts that trigger my desire to splurge.
I want apps or tools to help me track my luxury spending specifically.
I think I will try out Spendee.
I want tips on how to analyze my luxury spending habits.
I want to identify areas where I can cut back on luxury spending.
I want to identify patterns and trends in my luxury spending.
I have noticed that I splurge more when I am feeling stressed or bored.
I want to evaluate the value of each luxury purchase.
I want to look for more affordable alternatives that can meet my needs.
I think I will start by keeping a "feelings journal" to track my emotions and spending habits.
I want to understand what triggers my desire to splurge.
I want to manage my emotions in a more constructive way.
I want to find alternative stress-relief methods like exercise or meditation.
I think delayed gratification is a great strategy for me to determine if a purchase is truly worth it.
I will wait 24 hours before making a purchase to see if the urge passes.
I am open to seeking support from friends or family members.
Sometimes talking through my feelings with friends or family members helps me make more intentional purchasing decisions.
I love the idea of celebrating small wins to stay motivated and encouraged.
I feel like I am on the right track now.
